# QuieterWaterfalls

> Moved out of `CLAUDE.md` on 2026-10-13. Text is verbatim; `[verified]` marks and dates are as originally recorded.

- **Source:** `src/QuieterWaterfalls/`
- **Ships:** `Zenderal - Quieter Waterfalls.esp`
- **FormID block:** none (overrides only)

## What it does

**GENERATED by `src/QuieterWaterfalls/tools/01-quieter-waterfalls.py` — never hand-edit `SoundDescriptors/`.** 72 SNDR overrides (every EditorID matching `aterfall|WaterRapids`), `StaticAttenuation` = live winner + 6 dB (`EXTRA_DB`; higher = quieter, absent = 0). Why: `Reverb and Ambiance Overhaul - Enderal.esp` (RAO, load 227) wins 67 of them and LOWERED attenuation on many — distant loops most (`AMBWaterfallLargeDistantLPSD` 5.29→2, `…MediumDistantCloseLPSD` 5.29→1, `…MediumDistantLPSD` 7.93→0). Waterfalls have **no category of their own** (they share `AudioCategoryMuteSubmerged 0F23BB` / RAO's `_00E_RAO_AudioCategoryAmbient 00080D` with cave drips, wind, ship creaks), so a category volume can't target them. Winner set from a scan of every active plugin for waterfall EditorIDs: only Skyrim/FS, `Audio Overhaul Skyrim.esp` (204, fully overridden by RAO — the script asserts AOS never wins) and RAO. `Quieter Ark Temple.esp` edits only placed refs in `CapitalCityUpperTemple` — no overlap. Masters: Skyrim + FS + RAO (RAO's category FormKey), so the engine enforces load-after.

## The coast wind bed that "pops in" approaching Ark (added 2026-10-15)

**Symptom:** approaching Ark from any direction, a steady water/wind roar starts at full level at a fixed
distance instead of fading in (measured from a recording: about +20 dB within 0.25 s, then a flat −38 dBFS).
**Cause:** `AMBrWindBedCoastLP 0DB6DD` (a 2D coast wind bed; RAO moves it into its "Ambiance" category
and makes it 2.25 dB louder). Its only marker, `13C956` in `CapitalCityWatchTowerSouth` (Vyn −6,0, Ark's
west shore), plays it through **`SOMStereo 07EDCA`, which has no `AttenuatesWithDistance`**. So the bed
starts at full volume the instant that cell attaches (2 cells out with `uGridsToLoad=5`) and stops when it
detaches. **Fix:** the generator re-points `0DB6DD` at `SOMStereoRad05000Linear 09173E` (linear stereo,
200–5000 vanilla / 200–7500 under Audio Overhaul, silent before the cell can attach), forwarding RAO's
record otherwise unchanged. Region use of the descriptor is unaffected (region sounds play at the
listener). Confirmed in game by the slider test below; the fixed build itself is deployed but not yet
heard in game.

**How it was found (use this again):** record analysis and A/B mod toggling both failed. Every
"fixed/not fixed" run was confounded, because the pop only happens when that cell actually attaches. What
worked was **slider bisection**: a throwaway plugin moves groups of the suspect category's sounds onto
other audio-menu sliders (any `SNCT` with `ShouldAppearOnMenu`: here True Storms' three, Audio Overhaul's
Weapons and Waterfalls & Rapids). At the spot, set one slider at a time to 0 and close the menu. The slider
that keeps the sound gone names the group. The "Ambiance" slider (RAO `00080D`) → water group → coast
group → this one descriptor took three in-game rounds. Waveform fingerprinting of extracted loops against
the recording never produced a match (not even for this 2D sound), so don't rely on it.

**Ruled out on the way** (records checked, then rejected by test): the distant waterfall loops' 10k reach,
RAO's coast-wave model `0E360E` (12,383 reach, peak at 6–9k), Audio Overhaul's stretched linear stereo
models `08F3E5`/`08F3E3` (wind and seagull beds), Nordic Winds, Vynwood Echoes, Sound Record Distributor,
DynDOLOD's placed copies, acoustic spaces and region sound lists. The reach-past-8192 issues are real but were
not what was heard. They were left unpatched to keep this patch to proven changes.
